definitions.explanation: The lower portion or bottom area of something. Used in descriptions, instructions, and technical contexts to indicate the part that is lower in position.

examples.japanese: ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下部|かぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a button at the bottom of the screen.
There were stains on the lower part of the wall.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下部|かぶ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}→老朽化：07646_roukyuuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{補修|ほしゅう}→補修：15054_hoshuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: The lower part of that bridge is deteriorating, so repairs are needed.

notes:
{下部|かぶ} refers to the lower portion of an object, structure, or space. Somewhat formal; common in written, technical, and descriptive contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下部|かぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{位置|いち}する→位置する：09891_ichisuru⟧: to be located in the lower part
- ⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下部|かぶ}: the bottom of the page
- ⟦{車体|しゃたい}→車体：17213_shatai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下部|かぶ}: the underside of a vehicle
- ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下部|かぶ}: the bottom of the screen

PAIR:
Opposite is ⟦{上部|じょうぶ}→上部：11377_joubu⟧ (upper part).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{底|そこ}→底：12560_soko⟧: bottom (the very lowest point)
- ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧: below, under (everyday word, broader usage)
- ⟦{末端|まったん}→末端：06788_mattan⟧: end, tip (the furthest extremity)
